findings.detail: The fixed 128-cycle PASS requires only both raw accepts. It does not require any bank request/accept, result, or token_done, and it never compares functional outputs between the two DUTs. The endpoint may therefore be unreachable while the TB reports PASS.

The contract checker validates selected existing false flags but not exact key sets. Added K8, equal-bandwidth K1x8, single-K1 power, fair-energy, performance, system-speedup and paper-headline true fields all passed the target checker.

Replacing either the valid-qualified branch or payload-known branch with an unconditional branch while retaining the expected token in a comment passes check_endpoint_and_tb; the source checker performs raw lexical membership rather than normalized structural validation.

The target normalizer removes every tap assignment line and the topology checker accepts any assign tap_* expression. Replacing an exact fanout with $isunknown(...)?0:signal therefore passes both target checks and can hide the X being diagnosed.

required_repairs: Require at least one request accept per DUT, qualified result/token_done completion, and a class-aware functional comparison before PASS; preserve the first-X atomic bitmap and watchdog.
Use exact top-level and claim-boundary key sets, explicitly fixing the package to K1 diagnostic only with K8, K1x8, power, fair energy, performance, system and headline all false.
Validate the normalized always_comb endpoint structure or an exact pinned endpoint identity; comment-retained tokens must not satisfy the gate.
Validate an exact tap-to-source RHS map and reject $isunknown, ternary, case-equality or other X coercion on semantic fanouts.

release.next_gate: additive successor source plus a new different-author source/static/synthetic hammer
